# dsh-computer-use

Self-contained DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives the agent **computer use**: read windows,
click, t

ype, and screenshot any desktop app — through the computer-use runtime of the locally
installed **Ch
atGPT desktop app**. macOS (Apple Silicon) only.

It vendors only the macOS launch path of the original computer-use integration: it drops the
multi-p

latform host, the setup/update machinery, and any separate CLI, and reuses the CUA runtime
of the in
stalled ChatGPT app in place (never copied or re-signed).
## Prerequisites

- macOS on Apple Silicon.
- The official **ChatGPT** desktop app installed at `/Applications/ChatGPT

.app` (supplies the
original CUA runtime). The plugin reads it in place; it never downloads or modif

ies it.
- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3`.

## Vendored dependency

`@modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.30.0` is vendored under `node_modules/` because DSH links local
bundles

(`link:`) and does not install their npm `dependencies`. DSH ships the newer
`@modelcontextprotocol

/client` (v2); `adapters/client.mjs` is written against the v1 SDK, so the
v1 SDK is pinned and comm

itted here. If you move to a `file:` install or publish to npm,
`dependencies` in `package.json` alr
eady declares the correct version.
